pr_title: Fix slider ball facing incorrect direction during rewinding in editor
pr_body:
Closes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/20648.

The same thing actually happened during gameplay, but was less obvious due to rewinding running at crazy fast speeds.

issue_context.title: Slider ball points in incorrect directions in editor with Argon skin
issue_context.body:
### Type

Game behaviour

### Bug description

It looks like the arrow on the slider ball on a slider with the Argon skin always points in the direction it last moved towards, so when time goes backwards or you edit a slider, the slider ball points in nonsensical directions.

### Screenshots or videos


https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/17460441/194727615-d4985fcf-0b06-41a5-b7e0-1ca8d8a937fa.mp4



### Version

c169127f6ea31a8dd3f55168443f92c0da95badc

### Logs

[runtime.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/9740246/runtime.log)
comments: Interestingly, the logic is the same in the legacy and argon implementation, so this should actually be broken in legacy skins as well. I guess it's saved by most being symmetrical (or otherwise indiscernible)?

review_comments: This check is redundant, right? Or perhaps it was intended to handle the case where it is 0?
I'm not 100%, but I added it as safety to make sure the direction doesn't change when paused.
